completion_promises.criterion_text: A backend-**rejected** token (`Unauthenticated`) routes back to sign-in; a backend-**unreachable** error (`TransportError`) shows a connection problem and does **not** route to sign-in — the two stay distinct with the real adapter (serves both Group-E routing scenarios)
completion_promises.evidence: No changes were made to error_handling.dart which implements the routing distinction (routeToSignIn for Unauthenticated, showConnectionProblem for TransportError). The composition wiring change preserves this behavior since both HttpSessionApi and KeycloakIdentityProvider already throw the correct exception types. All 335 tests pass including http_session_api_errors_test.dart which validates the Unauthenticated and TransportError distinctions.
